sound.prompt: A handheld coal magnified to the size of a house. Fine dry shifting embers above a deep breath of hot air, steady, intimate, unpitched.

sound.label: line_strain
sound.prompt: Heavy wet fibre line loading under tension. One tight woody groan, fibres creak against each other, then hold. Dry foreground.

sound.label: drum_turn
sound.prompt: Hand-cranked wooden winding drum under load. Two slow rotations, close gear chatter, ending in a firm stop.

sound.label: brick_pass
sound.prompt: Reflected water slaps travel through a short brick canal tunnel. The tail shortens abruptly as the listener clears the arch into open air.

sound.label: ice_draw
sound.prompt: Thick ice plates pulling apart very slowly. Deep flex, splintering crystals skating across the top, then a hollow wash between the plates.

sound.label: melt_edge
sound.prompt: Close microscopic fizz of water eating a crust of harbour ice, opening gradually into soft trickling water. Unpitched, fine detail.

sound.label: sill_slide
sound.prompt: A floury heel of bread slides a few inches on an old painted sill. One soft wood rasp, loose crumbs drop. Quiet interior nearby.

sound.label: crust
sound.prompt: Fingers gently squeeze the browned heel of a fresh loaf. One intimate brittle crackle, soft crumb underneath.

sound.label: pier_knock
sound.prompt: A moored wooden hull nudges a timber pile once. Low hollow tok and a little answering lap.

sound.label: pawl_seat
sound.prompt: One blunt iron ratchet tooth dropping into a wooden winch, immediate attack, tiny resonant tail. Dry isolated hit.

sound.label: ice_release
sound.prompt: Single distant sheet of lake ice giving way with a long descending resonant twang, open air behind it. Distinct onset.

sound.label: rope_catch
sound.prompt: Heavy wet towrope coming suddenly taut against a stern post. One short hollow whump with a fibrous creak attached.

music.label: M1
music.description: 30 seconds, 120 BPM in four. Begin with a plucked low gut string playing a rising minor sixth and a single high answering note. A wheezy reed organ takes the answer at 4 seconds. Pizzicato eighths wind tighter at 8, fall into a single sustained breath under the bridge at 12, then open into a warm major chord at 16. Thin to one reed behind the handoff at 20. Return to the original two-note call at 25 and let its final answer die by 30. Small room, instrumental throughout.

music.label: M2
music.description: 30 seconds, 120 BPM. Five hollow tuned clay cups and a bowed bass. A lone cup rings on the opening beat. The cups pass a lopsided little three-note phrase from low to high as the bass walks beneath them. Muffle the cups at 12 seconds, let all five ring freely at 16, leave air from 20 to 25, end on a single low cup answered very quietly by the highest before 30. Intimate, handmade, instrumental.

music.label: M3
music.description: 30 seconds, 120 BPM. A small accordion in its lowest register plays a two-note working rhythm in short breaths. Muted viola enters in parallel thirds at 7 seconds, climbs into a hanging dissonance at 12, resolves into an unexpectedly tender sustained sixth at 16. Drop the rhythm for the bakery window at 20. The bellows take one last audible breath beneath the title at 25, with the chord settled by 30. Instrumental, no percussion.
